## Review checklist
- [ ] Scope is focused; unrelated working-tree changes are not included.
- [ ] Tests were not silently weakened, skipped or removed.
- [ ] No credentials, private user content, backups or operator-specific paths.
- [ ] Copied/adapted material has source/revision, retained terms/notices and modification records; THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md is updated when needed.
- [ ] Approval, plugin/MCP execution, network and data-retention impacts are described.
- [ ] Documentation matches observed behavior; no unsupported privacy/security/platform claims.
